_comment: DT-53: the daily goals, streaks and one-time achievements. Every rule is worked out by streaks.py from the stats engine. A goal's target is the user's (the goals table); `default` is used until they change it. A streak with a `goal` counts the days that goal was met; one with a `measure` has its own fixed target. `rule` is shown as written, with {target} filled in.

goals.label: Focused time
goals.rule: {target} or more focused minutes in a day
goals.explain: Work or study in blocks of 10 minutes or more with no phone distraction, on a computer.

goals.label: Social apps
goals.rule: {target} minutes or less in social apps in a day
goals.explain: Time in social apps and sites, every device added up. A day counts once it is over.

goals.label: Bedtime
goals.explain: When sleep started last night: from your health app, or the phone's quiet time.

streaks.name: Focus flame
streaks.needs: a computer's data for the day

streaks.name: Screens down
streaks.rule: {target} minutes or less on the phone after 11 pm the night before
streaks.needs: a phone's data for the night before

streaks.name: Logged it
streaks.rule: at least {target} meal logged in a day
streaks.needs: a device paired or sending that day

streaks.name: Synced
streaks.rule: every paired phone and computer sent data that day
streaks.needs: a phone or computer paired that day

achievements.name: First sync
achievements.rule: Your devices' first data reached the hub.

achievements.name: Full set
achievements.rule: A Windows PC, a Mac, an Android phone and an iPhone all sent data.

achievements.name: Perfect week
achievements.rule: A whole week, Monday to Sunday, with every goal met every day.
